name: Speed-ramp intro
oneliner: The first second whips in fast, then lands at normal speed.
description: A quick speed ramp from a shot of your business straight into you talking. 'Here we go' energy.
prompt: Open with a 1.5-3s b-roll clip of the business (doors opening, coffee pouring, tools coming out, a walk-in): play it at 3x for the first 60%, ease down (cubic) to 1x over 400ms, and cut to the speaker exactly on the first word of the hook. Add a short riser or whoosh SFX into the cut at about -18 LUFS. The intro must take at most 1.2s of screen time so the hook still lands in the first 2s. If there's no b-roll, skip the card and say so. Do NOT slow-mo the speaker while they talk and do NOT add motion blur above 20%.
